manual.noScript: Enable JavaScript to run this calculator on your device.
manual.manual: User-entered inputs · calculations run in this browser.
manual.synthetic: Synthetic example. Values are invented for demonstration.
manual.empty: Enter your values and calculate to see results.
manual.imported: Scenario imported. Calculate to see results.
manual.confirm: Clear the inputs and results for this scenario?
manual.bounds: Enter a value within the limits shown.
manual.fileError: This file cannot be imported. Use a valid scenario export for this tool, up to 16 KB.
manual.exportError: Calculate a valid scenario before exporting.
manual.numberHint: Use a decimal point, up to 6 decimal places, and values from 0 to 1,000,000,000 unless a smaller limit is shown.
manual.runsHint: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
manual.smallSample: Fewer than 10 runs. Small samples can make the estimate unstable.
manual.noSensitivity: Enter reward sensitivity to see optimistic and pessimistic results.
manual.farmFormula: Investment = cost per run × runs + additional costs. Gross return = reward per run × runs. Net profit = gross return × (1 − fee %) − investment. Profit per run and per hour divide net profit by runs or total hours. ROI = net profit ÷ investment. Break-even gross per run = investment ÷ (runs × (1 − fee %)).
manual.farmSensitivity: Sensitivity applies the same percentage decrease and increase to the reward estimate, keeping costs, fees and time fixed. This range is a scenario, and actual returns can vary.
manual.buildFormula: Gain = upgraded value − current value. Percentage gain = gain ÷ current value × 100. Efficiency is cost ÷ positive percentage gain. Upgrades within budget have cost at or below the entered limit. Equal ranks keep entry order.
manual.buildDisclaimer: Use the same damage and survivability units for every upgrade. These are estimates entered by you. The calculator has no access to the game client.
manual.economyInstruction: Complete one or more groups. Use the same unit within each price pair and within the benefit and cost pair.
manual.economyFormula: Conversion = amount × target units per source unit. Difference = price B − price A. Price change = difference ÷ price A. Net benefit = gross benefit − cost. Margin = net benefit ÷ gross benefit. ROI = net benefit ÷ cost. Benefit-to-cost = gross benefit ÷ cost.
manual.division: Results that would divide by zero are unavailable. Ratios displayed as percentages are multiplied by 100. Display values round to at most six decimal places.
